Input voltage abs max 15 V (p2); lower abs_max 0 is a placeholder floor not stated by the datasheet, only the 15 V max is stated: treat min as unknown. Fixed-3.3 V output 3.3 V typ (3.251..3.349 at VIN=4.8 V, 25 C) p2.
